messages:
mike: Quick RFC follow-up — we still haven't decided prefill (proactive rehydrate) vs reactive rehydrate for hot prefixes. Want a short plan (safety, metrics, rollout) before next sprint.

sarah: +1. Main concern is double-apply when prefill races with in-flight mutations. Need clear invariants.

dimitri: For correctness I'd like an 'apply-seq' tag on residency entries. If we only honor prefill that is newer-or-equal to last_apply_seq for the tenant we avoid regressions.

carla: That helps. Also think about credits: prefill shouldn't steal tenant burst credits. Proposal: prefill draws from a separate 'prefill bucket' that is rate-limited per-tenant and scaled by observed hotness.

mike: Good. Let's write a minimal API: pin(prefix, mode=soft|hard, origin=prefill|request). Soft pins can be demoted; hard pins block eviction. Prefill uses soft.

sarah: Observability: add metrics: prefix_pin_count, prefix_residency_epoch, prefill_requests, prefill_success_rate, prefill_evicted_while_pending. Alerts on prefill_evicted_while_pending > 0.5% over 5m.

nina: ops note: need rollback plan in case prefill causes memory pressure: feature-flagged rollout + per-node memory headroom gating. If headroom<10% auto-disable prefill.

dimitri: Atomicity plan: pin returns a token and sequence number. Rehydrate flow: prefill -> load KV -> compare-and-install if token matches AND loaded_seq >= token.seq. Example pseudocode:
```
// rehydrate
token = pin(prefix, origin=prefill)
page = load_from_epoch_store(prefix)
if page.seq >= token.seq:
  install_residency(prefix, page, token)
else:
  drop_prefill
```

carla: Also need a fast-path for reactive: if incoming request has live mutation it's allowed to bypass prefill check and do install with strongest seq. Document tradeoff: prefill avoids tail-latency on cold reads but reactive ensures freshest data.

mike: Rollout plan: 1) Feature flag off. 2) Low-rpm canary on non-prod. 3) Prod small percentage on low-traffic region with prefill_bucket=small. Monitor memory/eviction/latency. 4) Gradually ramp with per-tenant credit limits and automatic disable if headroom triggers.

sarah: Test plan: unit tests for token seq behavior, integration test for race (prefill arrival vs concurrent mutation), chaos test: random eviction during install. Add perf test measuring 95/99 read tail latency delta.

dimitri: Backwards compat: older nodes without token won't honor prefill token -> treat as token.seq=0; that's safe but we must gate rollout with node versions.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary/prefill-experiment -> cluster-qa at 2026-03-30 14:00 UTC :rocket:

mike: OK let's put this into a short design doc and a checklist. I'll open an RFC with these points. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
